purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Emuhaya Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (PyMuPDF render of the same source file; no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). A scanned green highlighter streak overlays the TOTAL row; the Wajackoyah, Total Valid Votes and Rejected Ballots cells were confirmed legible only after rendering at 600 DPI and cropping/enlarging that specific region of the same source raster (no separate document, no OCR).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (content-disposition filename F34B-038-215-0000-000-00.PDF, matching county 038 / constituency 215), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. No special/national voting-station rows (e.g. prison or diaspora facility codes) are present in this constituency's polling-station list, so the printed TOTAL reconciles exactly to the canonical ward-derived registered-voter denominator with no adjustment required.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
